Compare the result with the source fixture and the declared invariant. 5. Repeat or recover the operation when applicable; verify access, audit evidence, and side effects.
expected_result: The platform must correctly confirm every equipment workflow remains simulation-only; the corrupt input condition follows the configured contract; valid state is preserved, invalid or unauthorized work is rejected or quarantined without silent loss, retries do not duplicate side effects, lineage and audit evidence remain available, and no production records or credentials are used. Safety boundary: Use synthetic farm, field, equipment, weather, and crop data only. Keep all IoT and equipment integrations simulated; do not issue live machine commands or provide pesticide, agronomic, or environmental safety determinations.
